notes.title: Update 3.2 - The last update?
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hxq7fKg/update-banner-3-2.png[/img]

[h1]Fellow Character Enthusiasts,[/h1]

it's been a long time since the last update, but version 3.2 certainly was worth the wait imo. It's a huge content update addind lots of wanted stuff and there's a big announcement at the end, so keep on reading. Let's dive in with the updates first though:


[b]Added Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blaster
[*] Lasergun
[*] Double-Sword
[*] Great Hammer
[*] Knight Shield
[*] Futuristic Shield
[/list]

[b]Added Clothing & Headwears:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Bottoms (Hakama)
[*] Added Swordmaster Outfit
[*] Added Wing Helmet
[*] Added Sci-Fi Shirt
[*] Added Sci-Fi Armor
[*] Added Sci-Fi Helmet
[/list]

[b]Hair & Head Changes & Add-Ons:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked all sprite and bust hair colorings (hair, bangs & facial hair)
[*] Added two new facial hairs
[*] Added a new bangs style
[*] Added a new head style
[*] And the weapon mode got deactivated for now - read further for more infos about that.
[/list]


[h2]The Future of 8D Character Creator[/h2]
Low and I started 8D around a year ago cause we wanted to provide game developers (hobby or not) with high quality graphics and 8 directions to use for their projects. We started with 39 different animations, most of them with 8 directions available and all of them with 7 frames! After a short while we added the option for our RPG Maker users to export the animations using only 3 frames. But this wasn't enough. To make 8D available for everyone, we introduced the template creator, allowing you to export the animations in any format you like - suitable for every game engine there is!

We published so far 36 updates, with this being update 37. So we gave you new content and new stuff to play with more than every other week...FOR FREE. So after a really good run, we need to change something. This will be the last update of 8D...

in its current form.



[h2]The New 8D[/h2]

This is the last update for the web tech based version of 8D. There are multiple reasons for this step:

We are hitting limit after limit with each update, for example the number of animations / frames can fit onto a spritesheet
We can't easily add new animations
Adding new stuff takes a lot of time and adjusting on Lows side
We kinds reached the maximum amount of layers we can add
8D gets slower with each update and the export takes a long time
Things like the weapon mode are really hard to handle with the current tech base

So with those things out of the way, lets talk about the future!


8D will be rewritten from the ground up in Godot. There will be a "legacy" part included, providing access to everything within the current version of 8D, but in a way faster way with a lot more options.

On the other hand, in the little more distant future, we will move to a new animations system that will allow for way more animations that can be easily added & finally the ability to add stuff on your own / edit stuff!


What about the current customers of 8D? Well, you will receive the new 8D app for free + access to the legacy part of it with the way faster and more powerful editing options. So if you plan on buying 8D there's no need to hesitate, cause you will gain access on launch day... immediately... for free! The expanded 8D version will be unlockable within the software most likely and you need to own 8D to do so, which will stay at the current pricepoint.


If you have any questions about this, don't hesitate to ask in here, on our Discord or send me an email at support@8dchars.com.


Rewriting 8D from scratch won't be done within a week, but we start next week and keep you posted on our Discord! I plan on releasing the legacy part as an early access by September 2024 - maybe our community members will receive a sneak peak before that ;)

Thanks for your time and enjoy version 3.2 until we take character creators to a new level AGAIN!


- cub3 (Florian)

We changed exactly two things. Number 1: We increased the available range for scalings, so you can now scale your chars down to 15% of the available size. And number 2...

[img]https://i.ibb.co/DftRpx0/horse.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.content:
[h3]Fellow Character Enthusiasts,[/h3]

Version 2.2 has just been launched and it offers quite a lot of new features, so lets get us started.


[b]Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] With the last update we introduced a rework of all bases, hairs, facial hairs and bangs, but sadly some artifacts made it into the sprites that made them look bad upon closer inspection. So once again all hairs, facial hairs and bangs have been reexported and cleaned up!

[*] You want more content, so we deliver: A Roman Armor has been added. In the future we will try to bring you more content updates, so creating new stuff takes time.

[*] The pixelate feature can now be controlled separately for busts and sprites

[*] Same goes for body height and width control - change busts and sprites on their own as well

[*] A button has been added to enable an isometric grid behind the sprite if you want to
[/list]


[b]The last and biggest addition: Body <-> Head ratio adjustment![/b]

What does that mean? You can now create even more believable children, dwarves, gnomes and so on. It's now also possible to create CHIBIS - something quite some people seem to be looking forward to.

A little disclaimer: A few (3-4) animations are problematic when you go all the way with big heads and small bodies. Everything that involves hands above the head still have the big cutouts from the hairs, but the hands are smaller. This for sure includes climbing, carry walk & carry idle. So use the new feature at your own disgression!

Enjoy version 2.2 and let us know on our Discord or in the comments what excites you most about this update - thanks for using 8D!


- cub3 (Florian)

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
[h3]Fellow Character Enthusiasts,[/h3]

Version 2.1 has just been released. It might not look like a big update, but under the hood A LOT happened + some Quality of Life improvements and some new eyes ( O.O ) :)


[b]Here's the changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] New Animal Eyes added for Busts

[*] The Orc Bust now uses the selected noses

[*] Added the option to export smaller faces (down to 50px small)

[*] Added tooltips and headlines to the categories

[*] Added scrollbars to the containers

[*] 8D now starts with the last selected direction and animation

[*] Reworked all bases, heads, hairs, facial hairs and bangs to make the outlines sharper
[/list]

The last point is a big one. We really redid everything and split the layers so the recoloring doesn't affect the outline anymore. This leads to a way cleaner look and we think you will be really happy with the much clearer outlines!


That's it for this weeks update. The next update will include a lot of new stuff, but updates like this one are important as well. You may have to wait 2 weeks for version 2.2 so, cause it's a lot of work involved. As you know by now - the wait will be worth it ;)


- cub3 (Florian)
